title: The Finding of Jesus in the Temple: Fifth Joyful Mystery
summary: Pray the Fifth Joyful Mystery page by page: the story of the Finding of Jesus in the Temple, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a quiet reflection.

pages.title: The Finding of Jesus in the Temple
pages.body: When Jesus was twelve, he stayed behind in the Temple, listening and asking questions, and Mary and Joseph searched for him for three days. They found him in his Father's house, and Mary kept all these things in her heart. As we pray this decade, we ask for the grace to keep seeking Jesus whenever we feel we have lost him.

pages.title: From the Gospel
pages.body:
God's Word tells us this mystery. From the Gospel according to Luke, chapter 2 (Douay-Rheims Bible):

“And it came to pass, that, after three days, they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, hearing them, and asking them questions. And all that heard him were astonished at his wisdom and his answers. And his mother said to him: Son, why hast thou done so to us? behold thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing. And he said to them: How is it that you sought me? did you not know, that I must be about my father’s business?”

(Luke 2:41-52)

pages.title: Praying the Decade
pages.body:
We announce the mystery: The Finding of Jesus in the Temple, the Fifth Joyful Mystery. Then we pray one decade of the Rosary, holding this scene in our hearts.

Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name; Thy kingdom come; Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. (We pray the Hail Mary ten times, once for each bead of the decade.)

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to Heaven, especially those in most need of Thy mercy.

pages.title: The Fruit of This Mystery: Perseverance in seeking Christ
pages.body:
This mystery grows the fruit of perseverance in seeking Christ. Mary searched for Jesus for three days. When we cannot feel God near, we keep seeking him in prayer. Where do you look for Jesus when you feel lost?

Let us pray: Lord Jesus, when we lose sight of you, bring us back to you with joy. Amen. Our Lady of the Rosary, pray for us.
